| Pair | Field/Section | Producer writes? | Consumer reads? | Match? |

| Release Planning → Sprint Planning | `backlog_slice_path` in `.claude_current_state.json` | YES (STEP 9 terminal sync) | YES (STEP -1.1) | MATCH |
| Release Planning → Sprint Planning | `stage4_backlog_slice.md` content | YES (STEP 4) | YES (STEP 0 load) | MATCH |
| Release Planning → Sprint Planning | `amended_backlog_slice_path` (empty on fresh cycle) | YES (written as `""`) | YES (STEP -1.1 check) | MATCH |
| Release Planning → Sprint Planning | `design_gate_status` | NOT WRITTEN by Release Planning | YES (STEP -1.3) | CONSUMER READS UNGUARANTEED — Release Planning does not write `design_gate_status`; field must come from Design Gate engine |
| Sprint Planning → Sprint Execution | `sprint_backlog_index.json` | YES (STEP 6.1A) | YES (STEP -1.1) | MATCH |
| Sprint Planning → Sprint Execution | `sprint_sealed = true` | YES (STEP 7) | YES (STEP -1.2) | MATCH |
| Sprint Execution → Delivery Verification | `execution_state.json sealed = true` | YES (STEP 7 seal) | YES (STEP 0 check) | MATCH |
| Delivery Verification → Post-Ship Closure | `verification_status` in `.claude_current_state.json` | YES (STEP 9) | YES (STEP 0 check) | MATCH |
| Delivery Verification → Post-Ship Closure | `verification_report.md` | YES | YES (§4 inputs) | MATCH |
| Roadmap Rebalance → Release Planning | `next_cycle_unblocked = true` | YES (roadmap STEP 9 or post-ship STEP 10) | YES (STEP -1.6 hard gate) | MATCH |
| Amendment Cycle → Sprint Planning | `amended_backlog_slice_path` | YES (STEP 6) | YES (STEP -1.1) | MATCH |

> `design_gate_status` is a CONSUMER READS UNGUARANTEED field for the Release Planning → Sprint Planning handoff when Design Gate is bypassed. Sprint Planning STEP -1.3 requires `design_gate_bypass_authority` + `design_gate_bypass_reason` when entering from `Release_Planning_Complete`. This is a documented bypass path, not a gap, but the field must be manually set rather than produced by Release Planning.

AUD-2026-03-13-018 (idea_intake_prompt.md v1.3, 2026-03-14) added this field specifically to enable roadmap STEP 4 to read per-agent counts directly without re-scanning all submission IDs; the field was never produced by the updated engine.
**Evidence:** `claude/ideas/ideas_window.json` lines 1–113 — `per_agent_submission_count` field absent; `submissions_received` list present (44 entries); engine version at IW creation was idea_intake_prompt.md v2.1
**Recommended change:** `claude/system/idea_intake_prompt.md` STEP 3 (window close / JSON write) — INSERT `per_agent_submission_count` field into the ideas_window.json output schema; compute map from submissions_received at window close time
**Expected benefit:** Roadmap STEP 4 direct field read without re-derivation; eliminates silent regression from AUD-2026-03-13-018
**Token impact:** Neutral — no prompt size change; saves ~400 tokens/cycle in roadmap STEP 4 re-derivation
**Implementation effort:** Low
**Dependencies:** None

### AUD-2026-03-21-002
**Title:** run audit has no structural cadence trigger in post-ship closure
**Area:** Governance
**Evidence Classification:** LATENT
**Blast Radius:** 4
**Priority Weight:** 8
**Problem:** The `run audit` command has no auto-trigger in any governed engine — the only reminder is "every 3 cycles" in CLAUDE.md. The audit for this cycle was overdue by 2 cycles because `COMPLETED_CYCLES` in audit.py was stale, and no engine surfaced the overdue state; the user had to ask manually why the audit hadn't run.
**Evidence:** CLAUDE.md command table — `run audit | claude/audit.py | Governance — lifecycle audit (every 3 cycles)`; post_ship_closure.md has no audit-overdue check; audit.py COMPLETED_CYCLES = 3 (stale, actual = 5)
**Recommended change:** `claude/system/post_ship_closure.md` STEP 0 or STEP 1 — INSERT audit cadence advisory: read `COMPLETED_CYCLES` from audit.py CONFIG comment; if `completed_cycle_count` (from `.claude_current_state.json`) mod 3 == 0, surface "⚠ AUDIT DUE — run audit before next cycle opens" as a non-blocking advisory in the run manifest
**Expected benefit:** Eliminates manual tracking of audit cadence; prevents 2+ cycle audit overruns
**Token impact:** Costs — ~40 tokens/cycle (advisory check at STEP 0)
**Implementation effort:** Medium
**Dependencies:** AUD-2026-03-21-003 (COMPLETED_CYCLES must be correct for the check to work)

PATCH 1:
  operation: INSERT_AFTER
  file: claude/system/post_ship_closure.md
  anchor: "STEP 0"
  content: |
    **Audit Cadence Check (advisory — non-blocking):**
    Read `completed_cycle_count` from `.claude_current_state.json`.
    If `completed_cycle_count % 3 == 0` (i.e., a multiple of 3):
      Output advisory: "⚠ AUDIT DUE — completed_cycle_count = N. Run `run audit` before next Phase 1B opens. File output at claude/cycles/<cycle_id>/audit_report_AUD-<date>.md."
      Record in run manifest under Advisory Findings.
    This check is non-blocking — post-ship closure proceeds regardless.

PATCH 2:
  operation: INSERT_AFTER
  file: claude/system/OPERATIONAL_GUIDE.md
  anchor: "## 10. Post-Ship Closure"
  content: |
    **Audit cadence:** `run audit` is due every 3 completed cycles. Post-Ship Closure STEP 0 surfaces an advisory when `completed_cycle_count % 3 == 0`. The audit is non-blocking but must complete before the next Phase 1B `plan release` invocation when the advisory fires.
